title: Privacy policy
intro: We collect only what you type into a form, we use it only to answer you, and we never sell it.

children.text: MAK Minaret Enterprise, registered in Ghana and operating in Ghana and Türkiye, is responsible for the personal data described here.

Only what you enter yourself: your name, contact details, country, and the answers you give about your studies and budget. We use them to reply to you and to advise you. Nothing is collected in the background.
Your explicit consent, given when you submit. Marketing consent is separate and optional, and refusing it does not affect the advice you receive.

Only the providers who host this site and carry our email, and only so that your enquiry reaches us. They may not use it for their own purposes. We do not sell or rent your details, and we do not pass them to any university without asking you first.
An enquiry that does not become an application is deleted after 24 months. You can ask us to delete it sooner.
We work between West Africa and Türkiye, so your details travel between them. That is a necessary part of the service you asked for, and we state it here rather than bury it.
None. No analytics, no advertising pixels, no profiling of your browsing.
You may ask what we hold, have it corrected or deleted, and withdraw consent at any time. Write to the address on our contact page and we reply within 30 days, at no charge.
If you want more detail about how any of this works, write to us and we will tell you plainly.
